name: Witch Apprentice
source:
“The candidate demonstrates the heart and the skills required of a witch.”
That’s what the handbook for witches says, and Adriana is preparing to do just that. What is, “just that?” Who knows? The handbook is pretty unclear, isn’t it?

As preparation for the Class One Witch Examinations, Adriana has applied to apprentice under many powerful witches, and much to her surprised she gets accepted by three of the most powerful witches ever known – the Witches of Amalgam. That seems pretty awesome, doesn’t it? That is...until she learns they're all completely crazy.
